definitions.gloss: in an instant; instantaneously; in a flash
definitions.explanation: Happening in an extremely short amount of time, almost immediately. Emphasizes the speed at which something occurs.

examples.japanese: {瞬時|しゅんじ}に{判断|はんだん}する。
{火|ひ}は{瞬時|しゅんじ}に{建物|たてもの}{全体|ぜんたい}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The fire spread to the entire building in an instant.

examples.japanese: AIが{瞬時|しゅんじ}に{大量|たいりょう}のデータを{処理|しょり}する{時代|じだい}になった。
examples.english: We have entered an era where AI processes vast amounts of data instantaneously.

notes: Composed of {瞬|しゅん} (blink/moment) + {時|じ} (time) + に (adverbial particle). The base noun {瞬時|しゅんじ} can also be used in other constructions: {瞬時|しゅんじ}の{判断|はんだん} (split-second judgment). Common collocations: {瞬時|しゅんじ}に{判断|はんだん}する (judge instantly), {瞬時|しゅんじ}に{反応|はんのう}する (react instantly), {瞬時|しゅんじ}に{理解|りかい}する (understand instantly). Similar expressions: {一瞬|いっしゅん}で (in a moment), たちまち (immediately).
